column1: # milestone kinds → the skills a milestone of that kind must have pinned in at least one gated
# dispatch before `program.sh accept` closes it. Read by program.sh (`milestone add --kind`,
# `dispatch check --milestone`, `accept`). Groups are space-separated; alternatives inside a
# group use `|`; a group is satisfied when ANY alternative is pinned by an existing path.
# `stack` = any project skill or any laravel/web-dev plugin skill. A group whose every alternative
# is NOT installed is a WARN (fallback), never a refusal — the capability map says what to do then.
# `profile` (optional 4th field, default `ui`) is the EVIDENCE set `accept` demands: `ui` = the
# nine-kind browser walk; `headless` = `tests` + `run-log` for a kind with no screen to walk.

column3: default: any user-facing increment that fits no row below
a page whose job is to sell; direction before build
drag, reorder, kanban, calendar — pointer AND keyboard paths
a form that collects user data (contact, application, sign-up): validation, error copy, where the data goes — never `feature` (sim 4 m3 got no security or a11y group that way)
an HTTP or GraphQL surface other code calls
a game or any motion-heavy interactive screen — keyboard path and reduced motion are the product
merge the done branches into one tree and walk the product across them; close refuses divergent done branches without one
a read-only review, research or inventory pass: nothing ships and the deliverable is findings — no testing group, there is no new code to test; the suite proves the tree it read is still green
a non-UI code change with no screen: a script, CLI, package or build step — proven by a captured run, never by a browser walk
